title: Kissed Sweet Peruvian Milk Ceviche Clasico
description: A sweet and flaky Peruvian dish featuring sweetened condensed milk, served in a scallop shell, this ceviche clasico is a unique twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine. It is shojin-friendly and made with agemono-deep-fry techniques.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together sweetened condensed milk and lime juice until well combined.
Add the sea bass pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the marinated sea bass pieces in the cornstarch mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep fry the sea bass pieces until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried sea bass from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
To assemble the ceviche, place a few pieces of the fried sea bass in each scalloped shell.
Top the sea bass with mixed greens, red onion, and aji amarillo pepper.
Drizzle the sweetened condensed milk and lime juice mixture over the top of each ceviche.
